extends.reason: v10 proved live discovery/adaptive-expansion but execution failed for all 5 freshly-discovered targets with PermissionError writing to ~/.lightkurve/cache, which sits outside the interactive agent session's sandbox-writable paths. v11 fixes the environment cause (not a code change) and re-runs the identical pending search to completion, closing the full directive-required 'New targets' scenario end to end: discover broadly -> adaptive expansion -> create exact durable search -> execute exact targets -> persist results/provenance -> update follow-up eligibility.

environment_fix.root_cause: Lightkurve's default cache directory (~/.lightkurve/cache) is outside this interactive Claude Code session's sandbox-writable paths.
environment_fix.fix: Lightkurve honors the XDG_CACHE_HOME environment variable: if it is set and $XDG_CACHE_HOME/lightkurve already exists, that directory is used instead of the default. Pre-created data/.xdg_cache_sandbox/lightkurve/ (inside the repo, sandbox-writable, git-ignored) and set XDG_CACHE_HOME=<repo>/data/.xdg_cache_sandbox before invoking Run-New-Search. No source code changes were needed.
environment_fix.reusability_note: Any future sandboxed agent session doing live light-curve acquisition in this environment should set XDG_CACHE_HOME the same way rather than rediscovering this. See AGENTS.md's Python Environment Policy section, where this is now recorded.

full_new_mode_scenario_evidence.discovery: See hunter_live_acceptance_v10.json: real 126-tile MAST sweep at Tmag 4.0-4.1 returned 0 raw candidates, live-widened to 4.0-5.1, second real sweep found 13, create_search() selected the full requested 5 with zero shortfall.
full_new_mode_scenario_evidence.resume_note: The earlier v10 'failed' rows for these same 5 targets remain in target_search_history (append-only, never overwritten); completed_target_ids() only treats candidate_found/no_signal/no_data as terminal, so Run-New-Search correctly retried all 5 rather than skipping them, demonstrating the resume/interruption contract works under a real prior failure, not just a synthetic one.
full_new_mode_scenario_evidence.sample_scientific_output: Real per-target output includes full CandidateFeatures (46 fields), RawDiagnostics, HypothesisPosterior (6-way softmax), CandidateScores (fpp/detection_confidence/novelty_score), typed FetchProvenance with real MAST URIs and sector lists, and ExecutionProvenance -- not placeholder or mocked data. Example (TIC 101767697, one of multiple signals found): period_days=99.09, snr=388.6, pathway=planet_hunters_discussion, posterior.planet_candidate=0.309, scores.false_positive_probability=0.691.

verification.quality_gate_result: 10/10 gates passed, 3081 default tests, prior to this live probe; the probe itself made no source changes, only documentation and this evidence artifact

directive_scenario_closure.scenario: New targets: request N new targets -> autonomously explore broadly enough -> find best available N -> create exact durable search -> execute exact targets -> persist results/provenance -> update future target eligibility
directive_scenario_closure.status: CLOSED. All seven steps demonstrated live in this session (v10 discovery/expansion + v11 execution/persistence/follow-up), against real MAST data, on a disposable copy of the real production database that was never mutated.

remaining_limitations: This is one live run on 5 targets selected via a deliberately extreme discovery window (Tmag 4.0-5.1, very bright stars), not a broad production-scale run -- see v4-v8 for the existing 10,000-candidate/202-target scale evidence.

The environment fix (XDG_CACHE_HOME redirect) is documented for future sandboxed sessions but is not itself wired into any script's defaults -- an operator or agent running outside this sandbox does not need it and should not set it unnecessarily.
No external submission, alert, confirmation, or discovery claim is authorized. This remains local, disposable evidence.
